_readme: Masterwork (MW) weapons. GENERATED by docs/plan/tools/masterwork.js — do not edit by hand. byId[itemId] = index into items. Each item: name, baseId (the plain weapon), grade, wtype, hands, pvp, sa (special ability part of the name), mw (bonus name), skill (datapack item skill), bonus (text for the dashboard), effects (stat/op/val per the datapack skill level the item carries). Tags: GUIDE = forum topic 430, DATAPACK = L2J H5, INFERRED = ours.

forum.author: Scrapyard
forum.note: GUIDE: the author calls the chart "not complete" and "in rough shape" (sources l2j.ru, L2db.info). No L2Toggle-specific values.

sources.datapack: DATAPACK: L2J High Five (Shagooh) stats/items (Scripts/data/dp/gear_db.json) + skills 3825-3902 (Scripts/data/dp/skills/03800-03899.xml, 03900-03999.xml)

rules.scoring: INFERRED (user rule 2026-10-12): a masterwork weapon is never replaced by a plain weapon of the SAME grade unless the plain one beats it by more than the MW bonus (mwMarginPct of P./M. Atk.); a higher grade still wins. swarm.js MASTERWORK block (patch_masterwork.js).
rules.howToGet: DATAPACK: crafted (rare result of a normal recipe) or exchanged at the Blacksmith of Mammon (Foundation item + Mammon's Varnish Enhancer) — see mammonExchange / varnishPerGrade.
rules.enchant: Masterwork items enchant like any weapon. Enchanting is NEVER automatic (user rule): recommendations + the manual !enchant order only.
